prompts.name: tiles
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite sheet. Cozy top-down 3/4 view modern indoor office, Habbo / Stardew Valley interiors style. Hard pixels only, no anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, dithering or noise. Each logical pixel is an exactly aligned 8×8 solid-color block. Logical 1-pixel dark outline #2C2634 around objects. Warm palette cream #ECE0C4, wood #B07040, dark wood #84502C, navy #30385C, concrete #C4C0B8, plant green #489648, orange #E6783C. Even top-left lighting. Solid pure green #00FF00 background for keying. No text, letters, logos, watermarks or drawn grid lines. Objects isolated within their equal grid cells, empty space around sprites; floor tiles alone fill cells for seamless tiling. 512×512 image, 4 columns ×4 rows, cells 16×16 logical pixels (128×128 output). Row1 cream checker floor, light wood planks, dark wood planks, blue office carpet. Row2 gray corridor carpet, kitchen tile, corridor edge strip, doormat. Row3 navy wall top with wooden trim at bottom, left wall edge, right wall edge, wall corner. Row4 glass partition wall segment, open doorway, closed wooden door, wall with light switch. All exactly 16 tiles ordered left-to-right.
